summary: Minimal checkable plan: add a PhaseMessage dispatcher at the runtime boundary that validates the envelope against the PhaseMessage schema, enforces forward-only routing (LAW-001), idempotency by key, per-phase attempt bounds, and the approval gate (LAW-008), and that emits hash-chained handoff TrailFrames plus append-only trail events (LAW-010). Acceptance: a stdlib test suite covering forward dispatch, backward rejection, duplicate suppression, attempt-limit escalation, approval hold, and schema violation exits 0, and emitted frames validate against trail-frame.schema.json.
